title: The Bridgeworks
subtitle: One bucket of the sea that is not a sea
description: The bridge crosses the lava sea's narrowest argue, and the
foundations are pitched with the same stuff they bridge: one
bucket, a thousand millibuckets, handed over at the press.
The fluid task again, in the molten spelling -- the drowned parish
handed water over and got its empties back; the road hands lava
over and gets them back slightly less enthusiastically.
